entities.summary: Leopold Anton Wackarž, O.Cist (1810–1901) was an Austrian Catholic prelate who served as the 40th abbot of Vyšší Brod Monastery (1857–1901) and the 37th abbot general of the Cistercian Order (1891–1900).
